label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled param from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to host variable, which is used in InetAddress.getByName(host) for DNS resolution AND in new java.net.URL('http://' + host).openConnection().connect() for the outbound fetch. The isNonPublicAddress check validates the resolved IP but does not sanitize the hostname string before DNS resolution, allowing SSRF attacks via controlled hostnames that may resolve to internal resources. Resolved sink value: http://<user-controlled-hostname> reaches connect() call.

evidence.note: User input param flows to host variable used in DNS resolution and URL construction
Host variable used in URL.openConnection().connect() - user-controlled hostname reaches network endpoint
